title: Maria's Big Family
text:
Maria has a big family. She has forty cousins, but she has only twenty-five friends at school. Her class has thirty students. Every day, Maria counts her friends.

Maria's grandmother is seventy years old. She lives in a small house with fifty flowers in the garden. On Sundays, the family has lunch together. There are eighteen people at the table.

questions.text: How many friends does Maria have at school?
Maria has forty cousins but only twenty-five school friends. What can we say about Maria?
options: She has more cousins than school friends.
She has fewer cousins than school friends.
She has the same number of cousins and friends.

questions.text: Who is most likely at the Sunday lunch?

vocabulary.definition: children of your aunts and uncles
an area of land next to a house where plants grow
a meal eaten in the middle of the day
the mother of your mother or father

paragraph_translations: Maria ma dużą rodzinę. Ma czterdziestu kuzynów, ale w szkole ma tylko dwudziestu pięciu przyjaciół. Jej klasa ma trzydziestu uczniów. Każdego dnia Maria liczy swoich przyjaciół.
Babcia Marii ma siedemdziesiąt lat. Mieszka w małym domu z pięćdziesięcioma kwiatami w ogrodzie. W niedziele cała rodzina je razem obiad. Przy stole siedzi osiemnaście osób.
